a.description: Adult Zhuge Qing, navy-blue layered hair, narrow smiling foxlike eyes, small beauty mark, charcoal embroidered tailored jacket, open white collar and small green jade pendant. Plain matte-black wireless microphone with black grille when performing.

b.description: Adult Wang Ye, casual dark high topknot, intelligent sleepy half-lidded dark eyes, relaxed low eyebrows, indigo HIP-LENGTH wrap jacket tied at waist, white crew-neck tee and separate indigo trousers. Plain matte-black wireless microphone with black grille; understated confident acting.

zhuge_bai.description: Adult performer Zhuge Bai, blue chin-length bob, grey fedora with wine band, white raised-collar shirt, grey suspenders, dark trousers, youthful eager but restrained expression.

menren.description: Adult Zhuge-family teammate, broad square face, short dark hair, neat moustache and chin beard, white band-collar shirt and navy sleeveless long vest, dark trousers.

chulan.description: Adult Zhang Chulan, messy black hair, sly crooked closed smile, navy work jacket over white tee with orange-red collar, dark work trousers.

daotong.description: Adult Wudang teammate, earnest dark eyes, thick brows, modest dark topknot and plain wooden pin, grey-blue crossed-collar robe with white trim over white shirt.

tianshi.description: Lao Tianshi Zhang Zhiwei, dignified venerable elder with radiant evenly toned clean ivory skin, NO black spots, NO brown age spots or uneven pigmentation. Natural delicate elder wrinkles remain. Serene wise clear eyes, pure airy silver-white brows, long white beard and elegant white topknot. Black Taoist robe, grey cloud-jacquard collar, white inner collar, carved central judge chair. 仙风道骨、鹤发童颜、清癯高古。

lu_jin.description: Venerable Lu Jin, long straight center-parted white hair, white moustache and chin beard, stern watery eyes, black suit and white shirt, seated carved left judge chair, a white handkerchief kept low.

feng_zhenghao.description: Middle-aged Feng Zhenghao, slicked-back grey-white hair, round wire glasses, slate-blue double-breasted suit over blue polka-dot shirt, composed calculating smile, carved right judge chair.

xu_si.description: Adult Xu Si, tousled short silver hair, faint chin goatee/stubble, khaki jacket with small brass collar bars, white scoop tee and silver chain, plain matte-black wireless microphone low at sternum.

xu_san.description: Adult Xu San, neat short dark hair, rectangular glasses, black suit and open white shirt, black over-ear headphones on neck, professional DJ at the bronze and dark wood console.

baobao.description: Adult Feng Baobao, exquisitely refined natural face, very long straight jet-black hair, clear dark eyes, neutral unbothered expression, pale grey-blue simple work shirt. Plain matte-black stand microphone offset below chin, lips unobstructed.

lingyu.description: Adult Zhang Lingyu, beautiful dignified ascetic face, silver-white long hair half tied with dark ornament, white layered embroidered Taoist robe and dark waist sash. Serious calm eyes, plain matte-black stand microphone below chin.

shayan.description: Adult Feng Shayan, exquisite confident face, short icy lavender bob and side fringe, matching tailored lavender suit and modest smooth pale lavender high-neck top, seated second-row VIP guest.

zhanglao.description: Mature Zhuge-family elder, long lean face, swept salt-pepper hair, short salt-pepper moustache and chin beard, navy coat, white mandarin collar and navy suspenders, seated first-row guest with hands on a plain wooden walking stick.
